_rationale: Updated for the per-state profile model: CA state tax on $100k pension is now $5,438 (graduated brackets above $5,540 std ded), not the prior flat $8,000. Net CA = $100k − $13,170 federal − $5,438 CA = $81,392/yr. Net FL = $86,830/yr (unchanged). Portfolio: starts at $500k, accumulates net income each year with 0% growth. Year-1 balance = 500k + 81,392 = 581,392; year-3 (last full CA year) = 500k + 3·81,392 = 744,177; year-4 (first FL year, balance after CA-3 cashflow) = 500k + 4·81,392 = 825,569.
